spanish: Porque yo Jehová tu Dios, Santo de Israel, tu salvador; di tu rescate Mizraim, Kush y Sevá debajo de ti.

findings.issue: Hebraized proper names (Mizraim, Kush, Sevá) instead of conventional Spanish forms licensed by the proper-noun tokens
distorts the clause structure נָתַתִּי כָּפְרְךָ ... תַּחְתֶּיךָ by placing 'debajo de ti' after the names and omitting the 'as your ransom' relationship
